question: Which of the following is the state dance of Rajasthan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ghoomar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Ghoomar**

 
 
• **It is a traditional folk dance of the Bhil tribe performed to worship Goddess Sarasvati which was later embraced by other Rajasthani communities.**
 
• **Ghoomar** became popular in the Indian state of **Rajasthan **during the reigns of Rajput kings and is typically performed by women during gatherings.
